title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode5 A Small Flame

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What color should I make my next one...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The one I made for Saki has a cheerful color and fragrance to it... Shiho's is next, so maybe something more subdued would work best.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(As for Honami... Hmm...
I could just ask her what she'd like since she's right here... But I'd rather give one to her without doing that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that she'll enjoy it more if I keep it a surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. We can also make ones with flowers in them once you think you've gotten the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You bought some dried flowers earlier...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're called botanical candles. And there's no need to worry since they're also fairly easy to make.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, once we have finished scented candles like the ones we just made, we'll place them in a slightly larger mold.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That adds some space in between the candle and the mold, which you can fill with whatever flowers you like. After that, you'll pour in more wax...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it'll be done once it hardens.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, is that how they made all those pretty candles at the store...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It definitely seems much more doable after hearing how you can make them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It sounds a little more difficult to make compared to a regular scented candle, but I'd like to give it a try...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, while I'm at it, I should make candles with flowers that represent Saki, Shiho, Honami, Miku and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Saki would be... Mimosas...?
Statices could work for Shiho since they have this quiet and kind feel to them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What should I do for Honami, Miku and the others...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem to be really enjoying this, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed very happy just now. May I ask what you were thinking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was thinking about everyone who'd be receiving my candles, as well as which colors and flowers would suit them best...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I've been thinking about that too. I've been trying to figure out which colors and fragrances would match them best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...
I can't really make them like the ones they had in the store, but I'd like to make candles that put smiles on all their faces.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two were thinking about the same thing...? Is it normal for people to give their gifts this much thought when they're making them by hand...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I wouldn't be surprised.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami always brings snacks and treats for us during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means she's probably thinking about us when making them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami...
I'm really glad that I decided to make these myself today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean... You've helped me understand how wonderful and important it is to think about who'll be receiving a gift while making it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I finally understand how much thought goes into anything that's homemade.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, Honami, thank you...
I really appreciate you being our teacher today and everything you've made for us up until this point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, um...! I always appreciate it when you do make something for us! It's just... Making something myself like this has given me a better understanding of what goes through your mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Imagining is one thing, but you really can gain a lot when you learn by doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, the wax has already hardened...
These are the last ones we made, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... That's all of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! I was very impressed towards the end since you all were able to make them on your own...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, Ms. Mochizuki, we couldn't have done this without you. Thank you very much for teaching us how to make these...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um... It's nothing serious, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's just...
We didn't make any candles for each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I didn't make any for you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, while we're here, I'd like to make some scented candles for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we finish by each making one last candle...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since making some for all of us right now would be very difficult...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Instead, let's each make one and pass them around as gifts to one another. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...! Nice idea. I'd like to try that. Kusanagi, Kanade, what do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's keep making more scented candles for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They all seem to have hardened...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I just checked by touching mine... I think they're ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's remove them from the molds... Okay, they seem good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... How do you want to gift these to each other? Should we wrap them first?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We don't have enough bags for the people here...
So, how about we just give them to each other as is...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That seems a little odd if I'm going to be honest, but I guess we don't have much of a choice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I actually like that idea.
You don't get many opportunities to give someone a gift right after you finish making it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: True. Then, um... Mine will go to you, Hoshino. You'll give yours to Yoisaki, and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll give mine to Ms. Mochizuki, and she'll give hers to you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... I know it's a little early, but Happy Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here you are, Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! Oh, it already smells really nice. I'd like to light it as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy Valentine's Day, Ms. Mochizuki.
I really appreciate all the cleaning and cooking you do. I've been able to live with more ease thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
I also really enjoy working at your house, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Exchanging gifts like this is making me feel all warm and fuzzy inside...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
And as much as I want this to last, I'm really looking forward to using it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, then... Why don't we light it now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, now? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I see no problem with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, Kusanagi, could I try lighting the candle you gave me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I hope it works...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, let's light it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, wait.
It'll look prettier if it's dark, so I'll turn off the lights.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, here we go...
se_event_candle_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I like how the little flame gently dances in the darkness...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm starting to see why looking at them can help you relax...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And this fragrance... It's so soothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it is. It's gentle like...lavender...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There's no way for me to tell what Kusanagi was thinking when she chose this fragrance, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It smells so nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... Looking at it in the darkness like this gives it such a mystical feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I didn't realize that a candle's flame could be so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm a little moved by it too...
Especially since I made it myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Thank you for making me such a beautiful scented candle, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's hard for me to put into words... But it's like I can feel your kindness emanating from it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Stop, that's really embarrassing...
Still, I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um... To be honest...
I was pretty nervous throughout the day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you were?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes. I hadn't spoken to Mochizuki in a long time, and I didn't know anything about you, Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I was worried that I wouldn't be able to keep any conversations going with either of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you two are so nice that I felt completely fine before I realized it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, thank you for today...
I feel good about doing this because of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm also glad that I got to meet you today, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel the same way. I hope we get another chance to do something like this together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, let's finish by blowing out the flames on the candle.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We can blow on it at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, why...? Oh, actually...
That could be fun. It'd be like a birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... Ready? One, two...
se_event_candle_2023_008
